entities.summary: Foodpanda is a Singaporean online food and grocery delivery platform owned by Berlin-based Delivery Hero. Foodpanda operates as the lead brand for Delivery Hero in Asia, with its headquarters in Singapore. In 2021, it claimed to be the largest food and grocery delivery platform in Asia outside of China, operating in 11 countries.
